title: Concept: Sort code and account number pair in a response
description: A UK sort code followed by an eight-digit account number in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The pair is enough to set up a direct debit or a bank transfer at many institutions, and it appears together exactly as a payment instruction needs it.
applicability: Account summary, direct-debit setup and statement pages.
risk: The pair plus a name is a payment instruction; leaking it supports fraudulent mandates.
